notes: Chess Trainer v5.1: sounds reverted. The v2.1 sound swap is undone at Gaurav's verdict ('so funny now, the v2 sfx was better') — the sound set is again exactly the Lichess standard set that shipped in v2.0, byte-for-byte, with v2.0's behaviour (castles and promotions play the move sound; checks are silent, as in v2.0). Nothing else changes.
